situation: I'm a dog walker raising my 30-minute walk from $22 to $25 on Jan 1. First increase in 2 years. Texting my regular clients.
reply: Hi Megan, a heads up: from 1 January my 30-minute walks go from $22 to $25. It's my first increase in two years, and it covers insurance and fuel going up. Same walks, same photos of Pepper mid-zoomies. If you'd like to prepay any December walks at the current rate, just tell me. Thanks for trusting me with him. Jess
note: No apology for a fair increase; the prepay option is the easy win.

situation: 我是钢琴老师，一节课从200元涨到230元，明年3月开始，要在家长群里发通知。
reply: 各位家长好，通知一件事：从明年3月1日起，一对一钢琴课课时费由每节200元调整为230元。这是四年来第一次调整，主要是琴房房租上涨了。上课时间、内容和每学期的汇报演出都不变。已经买了课时包的家长，剩余课时按原价上完。有任何问题欢迎私信我。谢谢大家一直以来的信任。林老师
note: 第一句就说清日期和金额，原因一句话，已买课时包按原价是最重要的善意。

situation: Small coffee roaster. Raised our subscription from $18 to $21. A customer of 3 years, Donna, emailed that it's a rip-off and she'll cancel.
reply: Hi Donna, I understand, and I'd rather you told me than quietly left. The new price is what green coffee and shipping cost us now, so it stands. If it no longer works for you, reply 'cancel' and I'll do it today, no fuss. After three years of your orders, you'd be welcome back any time. Theo
note: Don't offer a quiet discount to the loudest customer; the others will hear about it.

situation: I run a small online ceramics shop. Our kiln cracked last week, so about 40 preorders of the fall mug collection that were due to ship Oct 5 will now ship around Oct 23. Need to email everyone.
reply:
Hi Megan,
Your fall mug preorder is going to ship later than promised: the new date is around Friday 23 October instead of Monday 5 October. Our kiln cracked last week and the replacement arrives on the 9th. The mugs themselves don't change; they're glazed and waiting for their final firing. If you'd rather not wait, reply to this email and I'll refund you in full the same day. Otherwise I'll email again the day yours ships. Thank you for your patience, and I'm sorry for the wait.
Jess, Clay & Tide
note: A delay, not a price change: new date first, one honest reason, an easy full refund. Unlike a fair price rise, a missed promise does earn the apology.

situation: I run a small yoga studio. From Nov 1 we're charging a $15 fee for classes cancelled less than 12 hours before, because no-shows are keeping people on waitlists out of full classes. Emailing our 200 members.
reply:
Hi Carmen,
From Sunday 1 November, cancelling a class less than 12 hours before it starts will carry a $15 late-cancel fee. The reason: our evening classes are full with waitlists most nights, and late cancellations were leaving mats empty that someone else could have used. Cancelling 12 hours or more ahead stays free, and if you're ill or something urgent comes up, just email me and I'll waive it. Nothing else about your membership changes. Thank you for being part of the studio.
Maya, Still Point Yoga
note: A policy change, not a price rise: date and rule first, one honest reason, and a human exception that doesn't need a form.

situation: 我在小区开了8年洗衣店，决定11月30日关店。不少老顾客会员卡里还有余额，要在会员群里通知大家。
reply: 各位街坊好，我是洗衣店老陈。店开了8年，决定在11月30日关店，这是我个人的决定。到那天之前收衣送衣一切照常；会员卡余额可以继续用，用不完的，12月15日前来店里或微信找我，按余额全额退。附近靠谱的干洗店我也问好了，需要的私信我。谢谢大家这8年的照顾。
note: 关店通知：第一句说日期，余额怎么处理写清楚，退款要简单；原因一句就够。

situation: I'm a freelance video editor. I've done monthly work for a marketing agency, Northlight, at $450 a day for two years. From January 1 I'm moving to $520. My contact is Aaron, and they have a big campaign with me running through December.
reply:
Hi Aaron,
I'm updating my rates for the new year: from 1 January 2027, my day rate moves from $450 to $520. It's my first increase since we started working together two years ago. The winter campaign stays at $450 through December as quoted, so nothing changes for the work in flight. I've really enjoyed working with the Northlight team and I'm looking forward to more of it.
Maya
note: Existing client: date and number first, one honest line, the current rate held for work in flight, and no apology.

situation: I run a small veg box delivery with about 180 weekly subscribers at $32. From Monday Nov 2 it goes to $35 because our partner farms raised their prices. I want to keep members who've been with us over two years at $32 until the end of February.
reply:
Hi Ruth,
From Monday 2 November, your weekly veg box goes from $32 to $35. Our partner farms have raised their prices this season, and this is what it costs to keep paying them fairly. Because you've been with us for over two years, you'll stay at $32 until the end of February. The box itself doesn't change: same farms, same Tuesday delivery. If you'd like to pause or cancel, it takes two clicks on your account page, no questions asked. Thank you for eating with us all this time.
Marco, Green Crate
note: Subscription increase: price and date first, one honest reason, a loyalty hold for long-time members and an exit that is genuinely easy.

situation: I own a small hair salon with two other stylists. From Monday Nov 2 we'll be closed on Mondays and open until 8pm on Thursdays instead of 6. Emailing our client list; a few regulars always book Mondays.
reply:
Hi Grace,
From Monday 2 November, the salon will be closed on Mondays, and on Thursdays we'll stay open until 8pm instead of 6. We're a team of three, and this gives each of us a proper weekend, which keeps us at our best for you. Everything else stays the same: same stylists, same prices, same online booking. If you have a Monday appointment after 2 November, I'll message you this week to move it to a time that suits you, and the late Thursday slots are open to book now. Thank you for sitting in our chairs.
Leila, Loose Ends Hair
note: An hours change is a policy change: the new days first, one honest line, what stays the same, and you do the rebooking for the people it hits.

situation: I make soap and sell online. We're discontinuing our best-selling Lavender Oat bar on Nov 30 because the small mill that supplied our oats closed and I can't match the quality. Lots of regulars buy it monthly. Emailing our list.
reply:
Hi Sam,
The Lavender Oat bar is being discontinued, and the last day to order it is Monday Nov 30. The small mill that supplied our oats has closed, and I haven't found oats that make the same creamy bar, so I'd rather stop than make a lesser one. Everything else in the range stays exactly as it is. We've made one final batch of 600 bars, and they keep well for a year if you'd like to stock up. The closest bar we make is Honey Chamomile; reply to this email and I'll put a free one in your next order to try.
Thank you for loving this one as much as we did.
Maya
note: Discontinuing a favourite follows the announcement shape: date first, one honest reason, what stays the same, and a real way to keep going.

situation: I run a small bakery that supplies croissants to 14 local cafés at $1.60 each. From Nov 2 the price goes to $1.85 because butter has gone up about 40% this year. Emailing the café owners; most order daily and set their own menu prices.
reply:
Hi Tom,
From Monday 2 November, our wholesale croissant price moves from $1.60 to $1.85 each. Butter has gone up about 40% this year, and we'd rather pay it than switch to a cheaper one. Delivery times, minimum order and the recipe all stay the same. I'm giving five weeks' notice so you have time to update your menu; if you'd like to change or pause your standing order, reply and I'll sort it the same day. Thank you for putting our croissants on your counter.
Rosa, Crumb & Co.
note: Business customers reprice their own menus, so extra notice and an easy change to the standing order are the practical courtesy.

situation: 我在网上卖手工曲奇礼盒，一盒12块卖88元。黄油和包装都涨了，11月1日起改成一盒10块，价格不变。想在客户群里直接说清楚，不想被人发现后说我偷偷减量。
reply: 各位好，我是小满曲奇的阿琳。跟大家说一件事：从11月1日起，曲奇礼盒从一盒12块改为一盒10块，价格还是88元。原因是今年黄油和包装都涨了不少。配方、用的黄油和每块的大小都不变。10月31日前下的单，全部按12块一盒发。谢谢大家一直照顾一家小店。阿琳
note: 减量也是涨价，要像涨价一样放在第一句说清楚，并给一个按旧规格下单的截止日期。

situation: I'm the volunteer treasurer of our amateur football club, about 60 adult members. Annual subs go from £120 to £150 for the season starting 1 January, because the council raised pitch hire by about a third. Posting in the members' WhatsApp group.
reply: Hi all, Priya here, wearing my treasurer hat. From the season starting 1 January, annual subs go from £120 to £150. The council has put pitch hire up by about a third, and subs are what pay for it. Nothing else changes: same pitches, same Tuesday training, same kit. You can pay in three instalments of £50 if that's easier, and if the new amount is a real problem for you, message me privately and we'll sort something out, no questions asked. Thanks for keeping the club going.
note: In a member-run club, the hardship option goes in the announcement for everyone, so it's a policy rather than a quiet deal for whoever complains.

situation: 町で小さなパン屋をやっています。これまで近所への配達は無料でしたが、11月1日から3,000円未満の注文は配達料300円をいただくことにしました。ガソリン代と配達スタッフの人件費が上がったためで、LINEでお客さんに知らせたいです。
reply:
いつもご利用ありがとうございます。11月1日（日）から、3,000円未満のご注文の配達に配達料300円をいただくことになりました。ガソリン代と配達スタッフの人件費が上がったためです。3,000円以上のご注文はこれまでどおり配達無料で、パンの値段と配達エリアも変わりません。店頭でお受け取りの場合は、もちろん配達料はかかりません。これからもどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
小麦堂　田中
note: 無料だったものを有料にするのも値上げと同じ形で：日付と金額を最初に、理由は一行、変わらないことと配達料がかからない方法を添える。

situation: 我开了一家小学生课后托管班，现在在明德小学对面，有32个孩子。房东要收回房子，11月2日起要搬到离学校步行十分钟的阳光花园小区会所，老师会去校门口接孩子。要在家长群里发通知。
reply: 各位家长好，我是星星托管的周老师。通知一件事：从11月2日（周一）起，托管班搬到阳光花园小区会所二楼，离学校步行约十分钟。搬家是因为现在的房东要收回房子。放学后我们两位老师照常在校门口接孩子，排好队一起走过去；收费、作息和晚饭都不变。如果新地址接送不方便，11月15日前告诉我，剩余费用按天全额退。10月31日（周六）上午10点新场地开放参观，欢迎来看看。谢谢大家的信任。周老师
note: 搬址也按变化通知来写：日期和新地址放第一句，原因一句，讲清家长最关心的接送，再给不方便的家庭一个简单的退出。

situation: I run a small online tea shop. Yesterday I emailed our 900 customers that 100g tins go from $14 to $18 on Nov 1 because of higher shipping costs from our growers, with the old price holding until Oct 31. The $18 was a typo, it should be $16, and a few people have already replied upset.
reply:
Hi Sam,
A correction to yesterday's email: from Sunday 1 November our 100g tins go from $14 to $16, not $18. That was my typo, and I'm sorry for the confusion. Everything else stands: the reason is higher shipping costs from our growers, the teas don't change, and the $14 price holds on the site until Saturday 31 October. Thank you to everyone who wrote back, it's how I caught it.
Mei, Leaf & Kettle
note: Correct a wrong announcement fast, in the first line, with one plain apology for the mistake itself; the increase still needs no apology.

situation: 我开家庭宠物寄养，平时每晚80元。明年春节期间（2月1日到2月20日）阿姨上班我要付三倍工资，所以这段时间改成每晚120元，节后恢复80元。10月31日前已经预订春节的老客户还按80元算。要在客户群里通知。
reply: 各位主人好，我是小林。明年2月1日到2月20日春节期间，寄养价格从每晚80元调整为120元，2月21日起恢复80元。原因很简单：春节期间照看毛孩子的阿姨工资是平时的三倍。照顾方式完全不变。10月31日前在群里或私信我预订春节的，都按原价80元算。有任何问题直接私信我，谢谢大家一直放心把毛孩子交给我们。小林
note: 临时的节日加价要写清起止日期和恢复原价的日子，大家才不会以为是永久涨价。

situation: I'm Anna and I run a small neighbourhood bakery with about 60 weekly bread subscribers who pay week by week. We're closing for a kitchen renovation from Monday Oct 19 and reopening Monday Nov 9; subscriptions will pause and nobody is charged for those weeks. Same bakers and recipes when we reopen.
reply:
Hi Tom,
The bakery will be closed for three weeks, from Monday 19 October, and reopens on Monday 9 November while we renovate the kitchen. Your subscription pauses automatically for those weeks and you won't be charged for them. When we reopen it's the same bakers and the same recipes, and your first loaf back will be ready on Monday 9 November. If you'd rather cancel instead, just reply and I'll sort it the same day. Thank you for your patience.
Anna
note: A temporary closure is an announcement like any other: dates first, one line of reason, what happens to their money, and an easy exit.

situation: I'm Jonas, the solo developer of Pantry Pal, a meal-planning app with about 3,000 free users. From Monday Nov 2 the free plan ends and the app costs $3 a month, because my server costs have tripled this year. The app itself isn't changing and there are still no ads; anyone can export their recipes any time, subscribed or not; and current free users get their first three months at $1.50.
reply:
Hi Maya,
From Monday 2 November, the free plan of Pantry Pal ends and the app will cost $3 a month. My server costs have tripled this year, and a subscription is how I keep it running. Nothing about the app itself changes, and there are still no ads. As someone already using it, your first three months are $1.50 a month. If it's not for you, you can export your recipes any time, whether or not you subscribe. Thanks for planning your meals with a one-person app.
Jonas
note: Free to paid is the biggest jump there is, so the exit (export) gets as much space as the discount.

situation: 我教少儿英语，已经在家长群里通知：11月1日起课时费从每节150元涨到170元，10月31日前买的课时包按原价上完。家长王姐私信我：“我们家老带新介绍了三个孩子，给我还按150吧，别告诉别人。”
reply: 王姐，谢谢您一直信任我，还介绍了三位小朋友来，我一直记着。新价格对所有家长都一样，我不私下给某一家单独的价格，这样对其他家长不公平，也希望您理解。10月31日前买的课时包还是按150元上完。如果新价格对您家不合适，随时跟我说，停课或者调整都没关系。
note: 不给最会开口的人私下打折，别的家长迟早会知道；把原价课时包和轻松退出这两条说清楚就够了。

situation: I'm Jen and I run a small farm shop on the edge of our village. Our cash box has been stolen twice since August, so from Monday Nov 2 we're going card only; prices aren't changing. Lots of our regulars are older and prefer cash, so anyone without a card can pay by bank transfer or have a monthly tab with me. Posting in the village Facebook group and on the shop door.
reply:
From Monday 2 November, the farm shop will be card only, no cash. Our cash box has been stolen twice since August, and we can't keep leaving money on the counter. Prices stay exactly the same. If you don't use a card, you can pay by bank transfer, or I'll set you up with a monthly tab that you settle once a month; just catch me at the shop or send me a message. Thank you for shopping with us.
Jen
note: A payment change hits some customers harder than others, so their alternative gets as much room as the rule.

situation: 我叫周敏，开了一家小保洁公司叫洁雅保洁，给一家设计公司的写字楼做日常保洁，月费6000元，一直是固定的两位阿姨上门。合同第6条写了调价要提前60天书面通知。今年保洁员工资涨了，打算12月1日起涨到6500元，对接人是行政主管孙经理，我的电话是13900001234。
reply: 孙经理您好，我是洁雅保洁的周敏。按合同第6条，提前书面通知您：从12月1日起，贵司日常保洁月费由6000元调整为6500元，原因是今年保洁员工资上涨了。服务内容、频次和固定上门的两位阿姨都不变，11月及之前的服务仍按6000元结算。对调整有任何疑问，随时打我电话13900001234。谢谢贵司一直以来的信任。周敏
note: B2B with a contract: cite the notice clause and check its exact terms before sending, rather than relying on general rules.
